description: One quantified expression cell: the measured value of a specific genomic feature in a specific biosample within a specific matrix.

id.description: Internal Beacon identifier for this expression value entry.

biosampleId.description: Reference to the biosample entry id that this value was measured in.

value.description: Numeric expression quantification for this feature in this biosample. Units and scale are defined by the parent matrix (expressionUnitAndScale).

featureId.description: Native accession of the quantified genomic feature as it appears in the matrix row. MUST equal genomicFeature.featureIdentifier.id of the matching feature. Not a CURIE and not genomicFeatures.id.

matrixId.description: Reference to the matrix entry id that this value belongs to.

title: Expression value
